description: Reference platform overlays for CG-7 French-door refrigerator rev1 discovery corpus. Manufacturer compounding overlays are a separate phase after canonical freeze.

platforms.label: Whirlpool Jazz French-door refrigerator
implementationNotes: R1 discovery manual — service tests 1-9 map to rev1 KEEP components and conditionalConcepts via overlay binding.
compressor is conditional — Jazz relay-drive test 2 binds to conditionalConcept compressor, not compressor_controller.
FF/FZ thermistor tests bind to conditionalConcept temperature_sensor with compartment scope.

gaps.note: Door light switch — R1 canonical; procedure binding deferred to compounding phase.

platforms.label: Samsung Bespoke 4-door French-door refrigerator
implementationNotes: R2 boundary manual — inverter PBA routes through platform-only compressor_controller.
Multi-fan topology: freezer-fan, fridge-fan, convertible-fan bind to evaporator_fan instances.
No standalone condenser_fan procedure — condenser_fan remains conditional 2/3.

gaps.note: No condenser fan diagnostic on RF23BB — C-FAN is convertible/evap path.

platforms.label: LG LRMVS InstaView 4-door refrigerator
implementationNotes: R3 triangulation manual — linear compressor via conditionalConcept compressor; sealed_system is platform-only.
Compartment sensors (E rS, E FS, E IS, E CS) bind to conditionalConcept temperature_sensor with instance scope.
lglrmvs-condenser-fan uses evap_fan seed id — platform tagging quirk; maps to conditionalConcept condenser_fan.

gaps.note: E CH/E CL leak cycle — LG platform aggregate, not canonical rev1.
